evaluations.Clinical_Evidence: High in vitro binding, but low endogenous MS presentation. Mutant creates anchor (Met at P2). Wild-type has Lys at P2 (fails binding).
evaluations.Mechanism_Summary: Rank 1 (7.21h). Confirmed high binding. Mutant Met at P2 provides +1.91h stabilization over WT (5.30h).

evaluations.Clinical_Evidence: Low stability / negative. Lacks hydrophobic C-terminal anchor (ends in Gly). Serves as negative control for length/anchor.
evaluations.Mechanism_Summary: Predicted low stability (0.65h vs 7.21h for 10-mer). Lacks C-term Val anchor (ends in Gly), leading to 11.1x stability collapse.

evaluations.Clinical_Evidence: Uncertain / weak class I binder. Primarily recognized by HLA-DRB1*01:01 (Class II MHC). Model should predict low stability.
evaluations.Mechanism_Summary: Predicted weak/sub-threshold stability (0.93h < 2.0h threshold). Matches Class II (DRB1*01:01) preference over Class I.

evaluations.Clinical_Evidence: Negative / very low stability. Ala at C-terminus is weak for A*02:01; no strong P2 anchor.
evaluations.Mechanism_Summary: Predicted sub-threshold (1.99h core / 1.55h trunc). Weak C-terminal Alanine and absence of canonical anchor.

evaluations.Clinical_Evidence: Confirmed binder / immunogenic. Leu at P1, Glu at P2 (sub-optimal for A*02:01), Val at P9 (strong C-term anchor). Modest stability.
evaluations.Mechanism_Summary: Predicted modest stability (0.95h). Valine at P9 anchors into Pocket F while Glu at P2 modulates binding affinity.

evaluations.Clinical_Evidence: Negative control. Poly-acidic charges clash with binding groove pockets.
evaluations.Mechanism_Summary: Rank 11 (0.18h). Dead last in stability; complete electrostatic clash.
